title: ASP.NET Core / IIS / Negotiate basic implementation
meaning: ASP.NET Core can use the Negotiate authentication handler for Windows Authentication.
In IIS/IIS Express hosting, Windows Authentication and Anonymous Authentication switches matter before the request reaches the app.
AddAuthentication/AddNegotiate wires the handler; UseAuthentication and UseAuthorization must be in the middleware pipeline.
Authorize attributes/policies decide which endpoints require an authenticated Windows principal.
The authenticated user is available through HttpContext.User / User.Identity.Name and may include domain/group claims depending on host/configuration.
boundary_notes: R01 explains the underlying Windows/domain model.
R03 covers multi-scheme use with cookies/client auth.
R04 covers deployment and troubleshooting such as SPN, app pool identity, and login prompts.
